methods.description: Derived FLOP counts for each tile encoder and multiplied by the average tile count to estimate total computational costs.

methods.description: Baseline whole-slide image model evaluated at 0.5 MPP.

methods.name: GigaPath
methods.description: Baseline model evaluated on the CPTAC PDA cohort.

methods.name: two-sided log-rank test
methods.description: Statistical test used to compute hazard ratio and p-value between low- and high-risk groups stratified by median EAGLE risk score.

methods.name: STAMP pipeline
methods.description: Open-source protocol and software for deep learning-based biomarker prediction from whole-slide images, used for WSI segmentation, tile extraction, and subsequent feature generation

methods.name: Canny edge detection
methods.description: Technique used to exclude tiles predominantly containing background

methods.name: internal cross validation
methods.description: Validation method applied for PathoBench evaluations

methods.name: MLP
methods.description: Classification head with an input size of 768, hidden size of 256, SiLU activation, dropout, trained using AdamW and a one-cycle policy.

methods.name: Early stopping
methods.description: Monitored through validation loss in a five-fold cross-validation scheme to select best checkpoints.

methods.name: GPT-4o in-context learning
methods.description: Multimodal large language model prompted with example images per class and query image for few-shot comparison.

methods.name: standard ABMIL
methods.description: configuration following a commonly used setting with single-head attention and bag size 512

methods.name: gated ABMIL baseline
methods.description: configured to avoid potential undercapacity effects by using full bags (no tile subsampling) and multiplicative gating in the attention pathway

methods.name: slide encoders
methods.description: combine tile embeddings (and sometimes tile coordinates) into a single embedding vector for each slide or patient

methods.name: EAGLE (Efficient Approach for Guided Local Examination)
methods.description: a two-stage framework that uses the pre-trained, frozen, task-agnostic ABMIL model CHIEF to select the most informative regions within each WSI, followed by detailed feature extraction from these regions using the state-of-the-art tile encoder Virchow2

methods.name: ABMIL
methods.description: Attention-based deep multiple instance learning model producing per-tile attention weights

methods.name: gated ABMIL
methods.description: Gated attention-based multiple instance learning model producing per-tile attention weights

methods.name: Lorenz curves computation
methods.description: Cumulative attention mass versus cumulative fraction of tiles computed after ranking tiles by attention

methods.name: Rank profile averaging
methods.description: Aggregating Lorenz curves across tasks by aligning tiles by rank position per patient and averaging ordered attention values

methods.name: PathoBench protocol
methods.description: Protocol using predefined eighty percent train and twenty percent test splits.

methods.name: stratified validation selection
methods.description: Stratifying validation selection at the case level for categorical endpoints when feasible.

methods.name: slide embedding averaging
methods.description: Pooling each slide separately and averaging slide embeddings to obtain a patient representation for TITAN and GigaPath.

methods.name: early fusion
methods.description: Early fusion of multiple slides per patient for models that do not rely on spatial coordinates.

methods.name: UMAP
methods.description: Dimensionality reduction technique used to visualize slide embeddings
